prose: Mark Zuckerberg announces Meta Enterprise Platform, 'the next major pillar' of the business: bringing Meta's full AI stack - the Muse agent, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code, and more - to businesses and developers. The stated thesis is that superintelligence creates new opportunities and Meta's strengths (advanced models, leading agents, infrastructure scale, years of business relationships) are few companies' match. Chirantan 'CJ' Desai joins from MongoDB as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer, reporting directly to Zuckerberg.
highlights: Zuckerberg launches Meta Enterprise Platform as a 'next major pillar'
Brings Muse agent, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, and Muse Code to businesses
CJ Desai (ex-MongoDB CEO) joins as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer reporting to Zuckerberg
Thesis: superintelligence creates opportunities Meta's scale is built to serve
quotes: the next major pillar of our business
